title: IUNU: Building the Future of Growing - AIX | AI Expert Network
content: IUNU, a Seattle-based startup founded in 2013, is pioneering the future of controlled environment agriculture (CEA). The company focuses on using artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision to improve greenhouse efficiency, sustainability, and profitability. Through its flagship product, the LUNA platform, IUNU provides real-time, plant-level insights that empower growers to optimize their operations. The company’s technology aims to revolutionize the greenhouse industry by automating [...] IUNU operates within the controlled environment agriculture (CEA) sector, which includes greenhouse operations, vertical farms, and indoor growing systems. The CEA market is poised for significant growth as demand for locally grown, sustainable food continues to rise. IUNU is specifically targeting the greenhouse segment, where it has seen impressive growth, particularly in its vine-crop segment, which has grown by 330%. title: Seeding Success: AI's Growing Role in Sustainable Agriculture - PepsiCo Greenhouse Program
content:
In Southeast Asia, several incubators and accelerators are fostering an enabling ecosystem for agritech start-ups to leverage AI technologies. For instance, corporate-led initiatives such as PepsiCo’s Greenhouse Accelerator Program nurture and support start-ups addressing food security and sustainability challenges. Some of these challenges include pest and disease management, supply chain inefficiencies and post-harvest losses.
